response.sql: WITH filtered AS (SELECT driverId, points, wins FROM driverStandings WHERE points >= 1.0), per_driver AS (SELECT driverId, AVG(points) AS avg_points, AVG(wins) AS avg_wins FROM filtered GROUP BY driverId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_avg_wins FROM per_driver) SELECT p.driverId, p.avg_points, p.avg_wins, p.avg_wins - o.mean_avg_wins AS wins_diff FROM per_driver AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.mean_avg_wins IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (p.avg_wins - o.mean_avg_wins) IS NULL, (p.avg_wins - o.mean_avg_wins) DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The points >= 1.0 filter is applied to each driverStandings record before averaging; records with NULL points are excluded by it, and NULL wins are ignored by AVG.
Per-driver averages span all seasons and rounds for that driver, using the stored season-to-date values for points and wins, as the verified notes describe.
If the overall mean of per-driver average wins is NULL, the query returns no rows, which implements the 'proceed only if that mean exists' condition.
Drivers with equal wins_diff have no specified order, so which drivers appear at the LIMIT 10 boundary in a tie is undefined.
